Polyethylene wire insulation was tested: Polyethylene wire insulation was tested 4 times. It ignited in 4 of them. The flame spread in 3. Test conditions: about 21% oxygen and 1 atm, microgravity. This is a specimen proxy, not a test of your product.

This collection contains simulated lunar: This collection contains simulated lunar-gravity studies and a planned FM² lunar-surface experiment, not a completed lunar-surface burn test.
Buoyant convection is suppressed in micr: Buoyant convection is suppressed in microgravity. In WIF, airflow changed the wire-insulation flame; a single universal flame shape or spread rate cannot be assigned.
In Saffire-II a tiny gas-phase flame rem: In Saffire-II a tiny gas-phase flame remained after igniter shutdown, did not spread and quickly extinguished.

In WIF, stopping ventilation quenched th: In WIF, stopping ventilation quenched the flame. The report says this demonstration persuaded the Shuttle program to adopt ventilation cutoff as a firefighting procedure.
A historical test finding, not an operat: A historical test finding, not an operating instruction for another spacecraft.
